snippet.title: GG Party - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
🎉 Welcome to GG-Party - the ultimate online multiplayer party game for up to 8 players!
Laugh, battle, and party your way through chaotic mini-games that will put your friendships (and nerves 😅) to the test. Whether you’re playing together on the couch or competing online - GG-Party guarantees unforgettable rounds full of fun and chaos!

👉 Get the game now:
🔵 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1796340/GGParty/
⚫ Epic Games: https://store.epicgames.com/de/p/ggparty-ecf203

📢 Follow us on YouTube and Discord to stay tuned and up to date:
https://discord.gg/tdtRCRGYqs

✨ Features:
- Up to 8 players
- Controller Support
- Crossplay

Chaotic and diverse mini-games
Easy to pick up, endless fun
Perfect for friends, family, and every party

What are you waiting for? Let’s Party! 🎮🎊

Coming soon: Playstation & XBox
